long_biography.plain_text:
An overseas order for an early PC game showed Dmitri Bukhman and his brother Igor that software written in Vologda could reach buyers abroad. Dmitri was still at school when they began selling games online. They founded Playrix after studying programming, financed it from its own operations and eventually redirected the business towards mobile titles.

Playrix's global audience grew around games including Township and Homescapes, while the brothers retained majority ownership. Its success also financed Rix Capital, the family's long-term investment office. With his wife Daria, Dmitri founded Bukhman Philanthropies, whose work encompasses maternal and neonatal health, young people's mental wellbeing and literature.
